title: Refurbishing a pump fleet on value curves, checked against Pyomo
heading: A Second Tool Checks the Formulation
cases: each pump's five values are the failure cost its refurbishment depth avoids over the horizon
with only wearing-out pumps, the plan's value equals that of a Pyomo Piecewise model of the same curves
